title: Schedule of Conversion Credit Shares and Windows for Virtual Care
content:
When a Virtual Care encounter is converted to an in-person visit, two figures of the visit type apply: the conversion credit share and the conversion window.

## Definitions

- **Conversion credit share** — the share, in percent, of the virtual encounter's patient charge that is credited toward the in-person visit the encounter is converted to.
- **Conversion window** — the number of calendar days after the conversion within which the in-person visit must occur to receive the credit.

## Schedule

| Visit type | Conversion credit share | Conversion window |
|---|---|---|
| Portal E-Visit | 100 percent | 7 calendar days |
| Audio-Only Phone Visit | 100 percent | 7 calendar days |
| Primary Care Video Visit | 100 percent | 7 calendar days |
| Behavioral Health Video Visit | 0 percent | 0 calendar days |
| Specialty Video Follow-Up | 50 percent | 14 calendar days |
| On-Demand Virtual Urgent Care | 100 percent | 3 calendar days |

## Reading the schedule

- Four visit types carry a 100 percent share. Their windows differ: 7 calendar days for the Portal E-Visit, the Audio-Only Phone Visit and the Primary Care Video Visit, and 3 calendar days for On-Demand Virtual Urgent Care.
- The Specialty Video Follow-Up carries a 50 percent share with the longest window, 14 calendar days.
- The Behavioral Health Video Visit carries a 0 percent share and a 0-day window.

## Illustration of the share (hypothetical figures)

The patient charges below are hypothetical and are not Virtual Care prices.

| Hypothetical patient charge | Conversion credit share | Amount the share represents |
|---|---|---|
| $100.00 | 100 percent | $100.00 |
| $100.00 | 50 percent | $50.00 |
| $30.00 | 50 percent | $15.00 |
| $100.00 | 0 percent | $0.00 |

The share is the patient charge of the virtual encounter multiplied by the percentage.
